name: dmma_syrk
desc: DMMA.8x8x4 f64 SYRK (CUTLASS 31_basic_syrk op class): one warp computes the symmetric rank-k update D=alpha*A*Aᵀ+beta*C on the lower triangle (i>=j) via the warp-true m8n8k4 atom with B:=A; strict upper triangle is left canary (triangular write-set audit).
